messages.速度が最も低い味方を支援し、沈潜と攻撃威力減少を入れる指揮官。: A commander that supports the slowest ally while inflicting Sinking and Attack Power Down.
messages.味方の支援: S1「指揮」は的中時に速度が最も低い味方へ保護を付与。S2「攻撃命: **Supporting allies**: S1 Order gives Protection to the slowest ally on hit. S2 Onslaught Command gives 1 Attack Power Up and Damage Up to the slowest ally.
messages.沈潜: S1は対象の沈潜5以上でスキル威力+2。S3「気合」は沈潜5(表面的中な: **Sinking**: S1 gains +2 Skill Power if the target has at least 5 Sinking. S3 Focus is a 1-Coin skill that inflicts 5 Sinking (plus 4 more on Heads Hit) and 2 Attack Power Down.
messages.バトルパッシブ「士気高揚」(怠惰×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターン開始時: **Combat passive — Morale Boost (2 Sloth Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At the start of the next turn, gives 2 Haste to herself and the allies who were on both sides of her the previous turn.
messages.S1・S2の支援は速度が最も低い味方に自動で入るため受け手の速度を意識して編成し: S1's and S2's support automatically goes to the slowest ally, so build the team with the recipient's Speed in mind, and inflict Sinking and Attack Power Down with S3. The passive also hands Speed to the allies on both sides of her.
